digest.component_or_area: ADR documentation and architectural decision record
propositions: ADR 0098 must record the approved RP-04 architecture decision that Rebar composes immutable non-secret operation configuration with separately owned provider-auth/runtime bindings at application boundaries without starting RP-04 implementation
The ADR must cite completed primary-source and maintained-OSS research for dependency behavior, current Rebar probes, and provider-specific credential/session injection semantics with exact sources

ADR 0098 must clarify that operation snapshots are immutable and non-secret while live provider capabilities and static carriers exist only in runtime bindings, and that static restart/redeploy rotation is distinct from SDK-native refresh

The ADR must narrow ADR 0049 only at the per-job retrieval/composition seam while preserving all unaffected decisions and must establish consistent relationships to ADRs 0008, 0014, 0041, 0046, 0050, 0059, and 0083
All external dependency and OSS behavior claims in ADR 0098 require specific primary or repository research citations; Rebar probe claims must cite recovery artifacts
The Draft Critique must identify or explicitly clear uncited claims, internal inconsistencies, missing constraints, and ADR conflicts before HOLD/MERGE authorization from maintainer
